targetTest: Adding a url marketplace the git host answers with a server error fails as network error - #1.1
expected: Each of the three rows (500, 502, 503) lists one failed child row under the failed block https://{git host}/acme/tools.git whose id is the source as typed, https://{git host}/acme/tools.git, with no @.
actual: Each of the three rows lists the child row with the id https://{git host}/acme/tools.git@https://{git host}/acme/tools.git; the step fails at the result lists these plugins.
semanticAssessment: Three scenarios ran, one per Examples row (#1.1 = 500, #1.2 = 502, #1.3 = 503). Each started Pi, armed the git host, ran the add, and passed the result has these fields step (kind cascade, severity error, needs reload false, summary Some operations have failed.). Each failed at the result lists these plugins step on the id cell alone: actual https://{git host}/acme/tools.git@https://{git host}/acme/tools.git, expected https://{git host}/acme/tools.git. The diff shows every other compared cell equal; the fix changes only the id, and all three rows then pass with the cause chain and the git host log unchanged, so the id cell is the only difference. No Pi start error, load fault, or undefined step.
